conclusion_ru: API публичная по документации, но из этой среды оба GET-запроса получили HTTP 403 и error code: 1010. Это сетевой запрет Cloudflare, не доказательство отсутствия публичных данных. Доступ не обходился. Оценка качества трейдеров Limitless на реальных данных в этом прогоне не выполнена.

facts: GET /feed/trading?audience=all returns recent public trading events with profile.account, newest first.
Last 24 hours only; page limit 1-30; opaque nextCursor.
Use all, not featured, for an activity-defined cohort.
GET /portfolio/{account}/history is public, no HMAC needed.
Limit 1-100, nextCursor pagination, optional fixed market filter.
Malformed address 400; address never active on Limitless 404.
GET /portfolio/{account}/positions supports public account snapshot; AMM/CLOB shapes differ.
Current snapshot is not a historical account snapshot.
GET /markets/{slug}/events returns finalized MINED CLOB trades, not all order lifecycle events.
Side is taker side: 0 BUY, 1 SELL. matchedSize is position-token quantity in raw 6 decimals. makerAmount and takerAmount currently both represent collateral cost, raw 6 decimals.
Public attribution is taker profile; example does not expose wallet address. Do not assume complete maker discovery.
Page/limit pagination; exact market/group slug, not stable alias.
Historical YES-price points are newest first; interval is lookback preset, no custom from/to bounds.
Resolved CLOB can append final payout at timestamp one second after newest retained point; this is not proven outcome knowledge time.
AMM buckets without trades can synthesize 0.5 points; these are not executable trades.
History covers one market lifespan; recurring markets require all historical instance slugs.
Price series does not establish contemporaneous depth or a copier fill.
Current order book endpoint exists; a complete historical depth archive was not established.

sampling_plan: Freeze a prospective cohort from every profile.account observed in an all-audience 24-hour feed window, before reading its PnL. Deduplicate addresses; never sample by profit, rank or featured status.

Archive every page with URL/cursor, retrieval time, body hash and API event time; record incomplete pagination and duplicate identities. Sample uniformly from addresses if a cap is needed, using predeclared hash sorting, not event volume.

Repeat windows over a predefined enrollment period to include infrequent users; keep entrants who later stop trading, lose, close accounts or have no positions. A one-day active cohort is not an unbiased venue-wide historical population.
For historical model evaluation, do not use a cohort discovered today as if it was known months ago. Need historical point-in-time market/address universe, or begin a forward holdout now.

Fetch full public history cursor pages per selected address plus all referenced market metadata, finalization timestamps, fee schedules and opening/closing position snapshots. No winners-only leaderboard replacement.
score_validation_without_lookahead: Fit baseline and candidate only on timestamped data available before cutoff T. Freeze features, gates, candidate score, eligible address set, copier policy and evaluation horizon before future outcomes.

Use historical outcome fields and PnL only as labels after their genuine publication/finalization time. Never use appended historical-price payout point as an earlier known forecast or executable price.
Feature quality tracks unknown/partial data instead of treating missing positions/history/price as zero or a 0.5 tradable price.

For defensible copier validation, record signal observed_at, bid/ask depth and fee/settlement rules contemporaneously. Replay after observed_at plus declared latency; strict limits and skip rules; mark unobservable fill paths unknown.

Keep related same-market and recurring-event outcomes clustered; overlapping positions/markets and common shocks must not multiply independent evidence. Separate maker strategies from taker-copyable strategies.

Evaluate realized copier net return, loss severity, drawdown, fill capacity, calibration and coverage on a locked future period; report score uncertainty and abstention. Do not select scoring weights using the same final holdout.
Current real record count is zero. No numerical Limitless backtest, score, or comparison is justified from this collection attempt.
unresolved_reconstruction: Historical depth, own observation latency, queue priority and impact absent.
Public market feed limited to finalized CLOB and taker attribution; complete discovery of makers, AMM users and inactive historical users unverified.
Cashflows, transfer/split/merge/redemption accounting must reconcile with history and on-chain evidence; current portfolio snapshot alone cannot establish past equity.
Historical fee versions, rebates and any outcome-token-denominated fees must be applied by actual timestamp, not current settings.
